name: Ram Hide Harnesses
label: Quest
description: Ram Hide Harnesses: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: While some of our soldiers are busy capturing wolves for the stable master, others must provide for the simple necessities that riding requires. I am speaking of riding harnesses, of course.
You must strike at the indigenous rams of the region. The very same rams that the Stormpike cavalry uses as mounts!
Slay them and return to me with their hides. Once we have gathered enough hides, we will fashion harnesses for the riders. The Frostwolf Wolf Riders will ride once more!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, soldier. I will notify you when I have stockpiled enough of the hides.
